notes: New: Doubao vision review for the dimension image (image 5).

A final quality gate sends the rendered size image to Doubao, which scores it against cross-border e-commerce criteria: all dimensions present and consistent, clear units, readable numbers, correct callouts, nothing covering the product, clean alignment and hierarchy.

If it does not pass, the app tries another layout and re-submits, up to 4 rounds, and only keeps a version Doubao approves. Every failing report lists the concrete problems plus a one-line fix instruction.
